headword: {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}

definitions.explanation: Income received outside of one's regular salary or expected earnings, such as bonuses, freelance payments, gifts of money, or lottery winnings.

examples.japanese: {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}があったので{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went on a trip because I had some extra income.

examples.japanese: {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}は{貯金|ちょきん}に{回|まわ}すことにしている。
examples.english: I make it a rule to put extra income into savings.

examples.japanese: {副業|ふくぎょう}による{臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}も{確定申告|かくていしんこく}の{対象|たいしょう}になる{場合|ばあい}がある。
examples.english: Extra income from side jobs may also be subject to tax returns.

notes:
USAGE:
Composed of {臨時|りんじ} (temporary, extraordinary) + {収入|しゅうにゅう} (income). Covers any non-regular income such as bonuses, freelance pay, inheritance, or lottery winnings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}がある (to have extra income)
- {臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう}を{得|え}る (to obtain extra income)
- {思|おも}わぬ{臨時収入|りんじしゅうにゅう} (unexpected windfall)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不労所得|ふろうしょとく}: unearned income — income without labor (investments, rent)
- {副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう}: supplementary income — regular income from a side source
